name: transcode-lab-curated-v1
description: Verified Python 3.11 <-> Java 17 parallel benchmark problems with differential test cases and semantic edge case coverage

problems.name: Add Two Integers
problems.pythonCode:
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Standard integer addition with positive, negative, and zero inputs.

problems.name: Factorial Calculation
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Boundary condition n=0 and n=1 producing 1; iterative multiplication.

problems.name: Primality Test
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Primality boundaries (n <= 1 false, n=2,3 true, 6k+-1 optimization).

problems.name: Integer Division Behavior
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Python '//' floors towards negative infinity (-7 // 3 == -3), whereas Java '/' truncates towards zero (-7 / 3 == -2).

problems.name: Reverse String
problems.pythonCode:
def reverseString(s: str) -> str:
    return s[::-1]
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Empty string preservation, single char, palindromes.

problems.name: Find Maximum in Array
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Negative-only arrays, single element arrays, empty array fallback.

problems.name: Count Vowels
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Case sensitivity (uppercase and lowercase vowels), strings with no vowels.

problems.name: N-th Fibonacci Number
problems.edgeCaseNotes: Base cases n=0 and n=1; iterative space-efficient O(1) computation.
